text: hey we are currently building the studio tool inside of hmsc-int, and we are getting to the texture point. well, i had a clean idea for img2img for textures, and i was thinking, it would be nice to bake in, with the useAssistant hook we have, a method where i can prompt for the texture i want, it sends the image to like claude, says the piece name, my description, claude can expand the prompt, send it in an api call, get the image back, then mask it with the cutout (we will have them) and then when all resolve can be put back into the main texture. the other claude working right now will be handling all the texture cut outs and such, im just wondering, whats the best way to setup the image gen pipeline with our useAssitant hook. since i have an aggregate provider with a TON of image models. and claude can just do a curl with the correct params

events.text: DESIGN LOCKED (paused, waiting on textureize cutouts/outlines from the other session). Texture img2img pipeline: useAssistant is TEXT-only (prompt enhancement), NOT pixels. Generation reuses cart/image-gen/ (nano-gpt = the aggregate provider): buildPayload()+postAsync, img2img via body.imageDataUrls data URLs, b64_json response, key from db.getActiveApiKey(). REUSE FIX FIRST: split generateBatch() into pure generateToBase64(prompt,opts,refs)->string[] (no disk save) shared by both the image-gen app and Studio. Pipeline: user prompt -> [enhance? TOGGLE, can bypass to go direct] -> Claude expands (one structured turn, claude_code) -> Promise.all generate per cutout island -> mask result to island.outline (textureize.ts TextureIsland.outline = the cookie cutter, req_1069) -> composite into island.slot atlas texels. USER RULING: deterministic cart-driven spine NOW + agentic generate_texture tool LATER (mirrors assist3d SET_SCENE_TOOL) + a toggle to bypass enhancement. Seam = textureize.ts SceneTexture.islands (slot+outline+uv). Phase 5d per MESH_EDITOR_PLAYBOOK 5.6. b64 -> data:image/png;base64 drops straight into Image/mesh textureKey (image_cache.zig decodes data URLs).
